title: City of San Diego & USS Midway Museum Unveil Newest City Street - “Midway Place”
description: The USS Midway Museum and the City of San Diego, partners for more than 20 years, have been working together for several months on the new “Midway Place” street in downtown San Diego. The new street is a tribute to the USS Midway for its nearly 50 years of active-duty service with the U.S. Navy and its more than two decades as a floating naval ship museum in San Diego. The street will be officially christened by the unveiling of the new street sign that will recognize the service and sacrifice of the nearly 200,000 sailors who served on board the Midway from 1945-1992 and acknowledge Midway Museum as one of San Diego’s most iconic symbols. Midway, the world’s most popular and visited naval ship museum, is the “#1 Thing To Do in San Diego” as per Tripadvisor. More than 21 million guests have visited Midway since opening as a museum in 2004.
